title: Human Approval Gates for Risky Tools
signature: class ApprovalRun: __init__(self, policy, ttl, clock, execute, log), state, call(call_id, tool, args), approve(call_id, approver), reject(call_id, approver), tick()
hints: Keep at most one pending approval and a FIFO queue. `state` is just whether something is pending.
Run the expiry check first in every public method, tick() included: if now >= expires_at, log expired, clear the pending call, and drain the queue.
Draining means running each queued call back through the same policy function a fresh call uses. A queued refund must pause the run again.
approve and reject only act on the call that is pending right now, from someone in the approvers list. Everything else is an `ignored` event.
